obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation with finite tests; not universal verification.
obernants.assumptions: Rust slice, integer and allocation semantics; standard comparison sort oracle.
obernants.domain: Finite integer slices and ordinary terminating execution including allocator outcomes.
obernants.observation_scope: One sort call or explicitly scoped internal pass.
obernants.operator: Within observations (input, budget, allocator outcome, Result, output slice), exclude changed input on Err, changed length or multiplicity, nonascending success, success past a range/budget failure, and error variants inconsistent with validation precedence. This is a source-derived relation, not just negative fixtures.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation with finite tests; not universal verification.
obernants.assumptions: Rust slice, integer and allocation semantics; standard comparison sort oracle.
obernants.domain: Finite integer slices and ordinary terminating execution including allocator outcomes.
obernants.observation_scope: One sort call or explicitly scoped internal pass.
obernants.operator: A successful sorted output admits every input permutation of that multiset, with budget at least its inclusive span and successful reserve; empty output admits empty input and any budget. Errors admit unchanged input with matching overflow, budget or allocation branch. Original order is generally not recoverable.

obernants.domain: Finite integer slices and ordinary terminating execution including allocator outcomes.
obernants.observation_scope: One sort call or explicitly scoped internal pass.
obernants.operator: For successful sorting S, S(S(x))=S(x). Translation by a constant preserving usize bounds preserves order and span. Tests check idempotence and the narrow span at usize::MAX.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived conditional relation with bounded correspondence checks; no universal verification.
obernants.assumptions: Valid Rust slices, representable arithmetic where stated, and allocator outcomes held fixed where required.
obernants.domain: Finite usize slices, exact multiplicity map H, fixed success and budget.
obernants.observation_scope: One whole sort or explicitly scoped internal state transition.
obernants.operator: For a fixed ascending y and successful allocation, S(x,b)=y iff H(x)=H(y) and b>=span(y), with empty input needing zero buckets. All distinct permutations survive; support alone is insufficient. Oracle histogram_fibers_retain_multiplicity_not_order enumerates 256 four-place inputs and finds 12 predecessors of [2,2,4,5].

obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived conditional relation with bounded correspondence checks; no universal verification.
obernants.assumptions: Valid Rust slices, representable arithmetic where stated, and allocator outcomes held fixed where required.
obernants.domain: Finite usize slices with representable strictly increasing image and separate admissible budgets.
obernants.observation_scope: One whole sort or explicitly scoped internal state transition.
obernants.operator: For strictly increasing f on the finite input support with every image representable, S(f(x),b2)=f(S(x,b1)) when both allocations succeed and budgets cover their respective inclusive spans. A nonlinear or affine map may change the required budget. Wrapping arithmetic violates the premise. The checked affine map 3v+11 and insufficient transformed budget are tested.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived conditional relation with bounded correspondence checks; no universal verification.
obernants.assumptions: Valid Rust slices, representable arithmetic where stated, and allocator outcomes held fixed where required.
obernants.domain: Fixed nonempty input, representable span, budget in usize, allocation fixed successful when feasible.
obernants.observation_scope: One whole sort or explicitly scoped internal state transition.
obernants.operator: For nonempty x with representable span s, successful budget antecedents are b>=s conditional on successful allocation; b<s yields precisely BucketLimitExceeded{s,b} unchanged. This is an upper ray, independent of input length. Repeated singleton-valued inputs need one bucket. The test scans budgets 0 through 6 at span 3.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived conditional relation with bounded correspondence checks; no universal verification.
obernants.assumptions: Valid Rust slices, representable arithmetic where stated, and allocator outcomes held fixed where required.
obernants.domain: Call transitions including range, budget and allocator outcome; ordinary termination.
obernants.observation_scope: One whole sort or explicitly scoped internal state transition.
obernants.operator: Validation partitions calls in order: empty succeeds; unrepresentable inclusive span yields RangeOverflow regardless of budget; otherwise s>b yields BucketLimitExceeded; otherwise reserve failure yields AllocationFailed; otherwise success. All error fibers retain original order because no writes precede reserve. Capacity overflow is deterministic evidence; physical allocator exhaustion is untested.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived conditional relation with bounded correspondence checks; no universal verification.
obernants.assumptions: Valid Rust slices, representable arithmetic where stated, and allocator outcomes held fixed where required.
obernants.domain: Internal successful counting and reconstruction over span-sized histogram; no allocation failure.
obernants.observation_scope: One whole sort or explicitly scoped internal state transition.
obernants.operator: After counting, H[j] equals multiplicity of min+j. Reconstruction writes disjoint intervals [sum_{i<j}H[i],sum_{i<=j}H[i]) with min+j. These intervals partition [0,n), including empty buckets; histogram zeros do not remove gaps from the resource span. Replacing min+j by min preserves length but violates values and histogram, rejected by the compiled mutant.
